answer: Each agent locks 0.01 token on chain A under a hash lock, reveals the preimage, and completes the swap on chain B within 10 blocks, so the ripple of the first transaction is mirrored on the second ledger under the same copper address. The ledger checks both carry the same hash lock and key. One honest agent holds 2 wallets and 1 hash lock for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must hold 20 wallets and fund 10 swaps, so costs rise 10X. An expired timelock or bad preimage slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
